label: AP analyst, every country says urgent

taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How much support did you get from your manager this week?
How connected are you with your team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: I'm finding it hard to prioritize my daily work because every country team emails saying their invoices are urgent. Since there’s no set priority order, I spend a lot of time asking around and end up missing my daily SAP quota by about 20 invoices. For example, last Tuesday both Vietnam and Thailand asked for same-day payment; I processed Vietnam first and my lead was unhappy with that choice. It would really help if we had a simple priority order from my lead, or just one dedicated person who decides which invoices take precedence.

Here is what I will tell HR: The employee finds it hard to prioritize daily work because conflicting urgent requests from multiple country teams lead to missed quotas. [ROLE_CLARITY] "I'm finding it hard to prioritize my daily work because every country team emails saying their invoices are urgent."
